fr_html: M. ADATCI est favorable à la création d'une Haute Cour de Justice préalablement à la perpétration des crimes qu'elle aura à juger. Il rappelle que, lors de la Conférence de la Paix à Paris, on a beaucoup discuté la question d'établir un tribunal compétent pour juger les crimes de guerre. Mais cette idée l'a choqué parce que ce tribunal aurait eu à connaître des crimes ex post facto.
en_html: M. ADATCI was in favour of creating a High Court of Justice before the crimes which it would have to try had been committed. He recalled that, at the time of the Peace Conference at Paris, the question of establishing a tribunal with jurisdiction over crimes against the rules of war had been much discussed. But this notion had shocked him because this tribunal would have had to deal with crimes defined ex post facto.
